verdicts.reason: Both candidates have the same problems. The flavour chips are out of order and butt into each other (Honey Rosemary touches Cucumber Mint). Blood Orange shrinks to an illegible tiny pill on a row of its own. There is a big dead gap between the chips and the copy, the Solstice wordmark sits below the headline, and the peach circle in the corner is left floating. A keeps a cleaner shared left edge for headline, wordmark and body. B misaligns its left edges: Solstice is indented (about x=43), the headline sits at about x=33 and the body at x=30. B's chip cluster also floats awkwardly in the middle of the left side, so B is slightly worse.
